name: Character count
summary: Use Character count when a textarea has a genuine maximum number of characters or words that users need help meeting.
whenToUse: Use when a back-end or downstream process imposes a real maximum and users benefit from seeing what remains.
Choose either a character limit or word limit that matches the actual validation rule.
whenNotToUse: Do not impose a limit only to keep stored answers or layouts convenient.
Use an ordinary Textarea if users do not need a strict maximum.

anatomy.name: Character-count form group
anatomy.description: The container carries data-module and one max-length or max-words configuration.

anatomy.name: Textarea
anatomy.description: A govuk-textarea govuk-js-character-count control has a label and references the count message.

anatomy.name: Count message
anatomy.description: A uniquely identified hint provides the limit before enhancement and live remaining-count updates after enhancement.

variants.name: Character limit
variants.use: A limit defined in characters using data-maxlength.

variants.name: Word limit
variants.use: A limit defined in words using data-maxwords.

behaviour: Initialise the official govuk-character-count module and keep its govuk-js hook classes.
Without JavaScript, show a static message describing the maximum and enforce the same rule on the server.
Do not rely on the HTML maxlength attribute as the only validation because it can prevent users from seeing how much they exceeded the limit.
accessibility: Associate the visible label and add the message ID to aria-describedby.
Use the module's throttled screen-reader announcements rather than creating a live update for every keystroke.
On error, link the error message and explain how far the answer exceeds the limit.
content: Tell users the maximum before they type and whether it counts words or characters.
Phrase remaining and exceeded messages consistently and localise all module messages.
Do not encourage users to fill the full allowance.

htmlExamples.name: Ten-character limit
htmlExamples.html: You can enter up to 10 characters
